name: route
summary: The 4-op FM algorithm router (audio rate): a switch over the 8 shipped algorithm routings (weights 0/1, Q15 0/32767), outputting the modulation into op2/op3/op4 + the carrier sum, specialized instead of a runtime `fm1_route4` (16 multiplies + 16 table loads → a selective sum, bit-exact). The modulator outputs are ×2. The phasor scales `fm` by 2^20, so full scale is eight cycles, and the operators' −12 dB headroom quarter-scales the path, so ×2 brings a level-99 modulator to four cycles of phase deviation, the OPM's full-scale index at TL 0. The per-operator feedback bypasses the router: it taps the level gain and averages two samples, so it reaches half that index, as the OPM does. (op1 = O1 is never externally modulated.)
